actions.reason: C0002 lacks significant biological support across all modalities (no RNA pathways, WXS, or CNV features survive FDR), has weak cross-modal consistency (low ARI, high PAC), and no technical confounders explain membership. No supported split, merge, or resolvable evidence gap exists; the evidence is insufficient to retain this set.

C0001 shows strong RNA pathway enrichment (25/50 significant) with coherent metabolic and immune signatures, stable internal structure (ARI 0.866, PAC 0.230), and no technical confounders. Although WXS/CNV are not FDR-significant, the RNA signal is robust and corroborated by reproducible internal structure, providing a defensible identity without dominant technical explanation.

C0003 shows strong RNA pathway enrichment (31/50 significant) and significant CNV features (9 continuous features, CDKN2A loss), with moderate internal stability (ARI 0.603). The concordant direction of BAP1 mutation and CDKN2A loss, plus absence of technical confounders, supports a distinct biological identity.
